# Kyle Daniel Gordon

> Kyle Daniel Gordon (also credited as Kyle Gordon) is an orchestrator, arranger and conductor based in Los Angeles. He was supervising orchestrator on Rosalía's LUX (2025), recorded with the London Symphony Orchestra, and has worked in the music departments of Oppenheimer, Frozen II, Star Wars: The Last Jedi, Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, The Mandalorian and The Gilded Age. He is not the comedian and YouTuber Kyle Gordon ("Planet of the Bass").

## Key facts
- Supervising orchestrator, Rosalía — LUX (Columbia, 2025), London Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Daníel Bjarnason, recorded at AIR Studios. LUX won six Latin Grammys including Album of the Year (2026) and received ten Grammy nominations for the 2027 ceremony.
- Film and TV: Oppenheimer (Ludwig Göransson), Frozen II, Star Wars: The Last Jedi (John Williams), Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, The Mandalorian, Haunted Mansion (Kris Bowers), Bridgerton, The Gilded Age (Harry & Rupert Gregson-Williams), Star Trek, Bluey and more.
- BBC Proms: lead orchestrator, Soul Revolution (2025), wrote its finale and played the Royal Albert Hall organ; arranger, Bond and Beyond (2026), played his arrangement of Radiohead's "Spectre" on the organ; arrangements for Marvin Gaye: Prince of Soul (2026).
- Composer: The Little Bird, premiered by the San Francisco Symphony (2026).
- Records: Romani: The Untold Story (Billboard #1 Classical Album, 2024), Baby Shark 10th Anniversary (London Symphony Orchestra), Grace Kelly with Strings: At The Movies, Mollie Elizabeth — People Pleaser.
- Orchestras: London Symphony Orchestra, New York Philharmonic, San Francisco Symphony, BBC Concert Orchestra, Seattle Symphony, National Arts Centre Orchestra.
- Education: University of North Texas (master's in music).
- Contact: kylegordonmusic@gmail.com
